1.consolidated_definition: Frecuencia modulada. Sistema de transmisión de radio que usa frecuencia modulada en bandas de 88 a 108 megahercios. Sigla anglicada, usual. MSG Radio adquiere estación FM en Puerto Rico
1.en_consolidated_definition: Frequency Modulation (FM). A radio transmission system that uses frequency modulation in bands ranging from 88 to 108 megahertz. The commonly used anglicized abbreviation is FM. MSG Radio acquires an FM station in Puerto Rico.
